name: AMBIHAIPAHAR, Ashvini (Ash)
research_notes: Initial pass 2026-09-16. Retained all six undated occupations in frozen parliamentary roster. Live handbook is a JavaScript shell; indexed official occupation excerpts corroborate roles but do not add dates/hours.

Important conflicting evidence: UTS primary alumni profile states JD enrolment in 2013, whereas Wikipedia says qualification achieved in 2013. Retain primary enrolment year and leave graduation unknown; do not assign 2013 as start of legal employment.

Indian Link first-person interview (10 September 2024) describes approximately a decade in employment law. That is not an exact, employer-specific or full-time duration and is not apportioned among union/AHA/law-firm jobs.

LinkedIn public search excerpt identifies PSI/Public Services International, Oceania Region, July 2015–2017, but not role, remuneration or hours. Direct profile retrieval failed; retain as follow-up lead only, not proven paid employment. Do not bypass sign-in.

Vinnies employer article confirms regional director in October 2023; Indian Link confirms role in September 2024. Wikipedia June 2023 start retained at month precision with secondary provenance, pending primary appointment confirmation. Neither observation date is silently used as a start/end date; final departure and campaign leave unknown.

Hospitality Legal is reported as AHA NSW's own law firm; 2023 association membership pack calls successor HTA Legal its firm. Do not treat two possibly overlapping AHA/Hospitality Legal titles as independent full-time intervals. Private company legal form alone does not settle codebook treatment of association-controlled work.

Attempts: official biography; UTS alumni/study pages; public professional-profile search; employer/Vinnies articles and annual-publication searches; union and law-firm date/full-time queries; Indian Link interview; association ownership material. Australian Hotelier full-page access returned 402; only public indexed summary used, no bypass.

Next follow-up: dated CV or historical staff pages for Sydney, ANMF NSW, ETU, AHA and Hospitality Legal; verify PSI role and whether paid; Vinnies appointment/cessation; historical university and firm control; leave and overlaps around 2022 council/2023 and 2025 campaigns. Last follow-up 2026-09-16. Advance initial nationwide pass before repeating exhausted searches.

Systematic follow-up2026-10-01: PSI2016 programme resolves coordinator title; FWC2018 correspondence adds dated ETU presence; HTA Legal supplies bylined professional output; council primary release confirms resignation and oath; candidate profile identifies explicit volunteering and community transport governance. These materially extend the record without converting observations into service boundaries.

Hours searches found no person-specific full-time statement. NSW24March2025 hearing search result mentioning full-time schoolteacher work relates to a different witness; not attributed to Ambihaipahar. Direct public LinkedIn retrieval failed; no signed-in collection attempted. PSI direct PDF unavailable and main domain robots restriction respected; public indexed programme used with limitation.

Remaining follow-up: primary personal service dates/hours for Sydney, ANMF, ETU, AHA and Hospitality Legal; PSI appointment/remuneration; Vinnies start/end and campaign leave; university historical control and association-owned-firm headline treatment; JD date conflict. Avoid repeating broad career queries unless new staff archives or detailed professional evidence become available.

Second follow-up2026-10-02: targeted historical role/profile index supplies previously absent UniversityofSydneyJanuary2008–January2014employment boundaries. Historic2013annualreport documents nonprofit/Senate institutional structure. Degree completion is not an assumed employment start; observedprofilemonths independently supportdates.

Union/law-firm targeted searches supplied no new personal boundaries or hours. Do not infer law teaching from poorly punctuated secondary candidate summary; primary interview describes anatomy teaching and separate law degree. Next leads:2008–14schoolstaff directories/contracts, ANMFandETUlegalstaff transitions, AHA/HospitalityLegalappointments, Vinniescampaignleave.

Further2October pass after nationwide follow-up: targeted2014/2019/2020 employer queries produced public ETU-pairedJanuary2014–December2020 profile interval, corroborated in employer identity by existing2018 FWC correspondence. No direct profile retry. New Vinnies Winter2025 magazine p24 calls her Metropolitan Regional Director while reporting election, but does not establish employment continued after election, departure date or campaign leave. ANMF/AHA/Hospitality Legal queries still no person-specific boundaries. Next seek union payroll/title transitions and leave records, and legal-firm appointment notice; do not derive ANMF dates from remaining gaps.

Follow-up 2026-10-04: Fair Work Commission-filed correspondence establishes AHA NSW Senior Lawyer activity on 15 August 2022. Vinnies' April 2025 Broken Bay newsletter says an acting regional director had covered the role since February while Ambihaipahar was on leave, supplying the first primary campaign-leave evidence. Neither observation establishes appointment/cessation, hours, whether leave was paid or whether AHA and Hospitality Legal were separate jobs.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Recovered original StGeorgeCommunityTransport2021 and2022 reports, establishing earlier primary volunteer-board membership and own nearly-year tenure statement; reporting/compilation dates not converted into appointment days. ANMF/NSWNMAand2021HospitalityLegal searches found no personalemployment dates. FWC2019CEPUappearance only corroborates existingunionrole; sourcewebUnicodeerror and ordinaryHTTP403, no further retry. No substantiveFTpersonal evidence or unionsecondment/payroll proof; remainingunknowns retained.

2026-10-05 own25August2025housing speech newly establishes full-time work alongside study, employer/interval unallocated. No blanket FT inference for named roles. New Advoc8 indexed parliamentary lead says anatomy department about eight years, in tension with2008–14profile; full fetch returned non-retryable500redirect, so preserve existing dates and seek original Hansard before resolving. Targeted ANMF/AHA/HospitalityLegal queries added no payroll boundaries; job advertisements concern her staff and are not her own employment.

Second targeted pass: council annual report2022/23 p73 adds previously omitted Graduate Certificate in Professional Legal Practice as excluded study, institution/dates unknown. Over-nine-year solicitor summary is not allocated or back-calculated among ETU/ANMF/AHA/Hospitality employment. Primary UTS profile reconfirmed2013 enrolment, not graduation; council oath26 September2022 distinguished from countback election. Targeted first-speech/eight-year-anatomy searches returned no original supporting transcript; conflicting lead retained, no calendar or FT inference. Existing full-time housing statement remains unallocated to employer/date; leave and legal-hour gaps persist.

Third national follow-up2026-10-06 materially expands the record from a previously underused candidate biography: distinct work for UTS, the NSW Guardianship Tribunal and Salvos Legal Humanitarian is now retained separately from study and volunteering, with role/pay/date/hour limitations explicit. FWC-filed correspondence supplies ETU title observations: National Junior Industrial Officer on23October2018 and National Industrial Officer on23April2020, refining progression inside the existing2014–2020 interval without inventing promotion days. The official occupation's legal-counsel label remains as a broader conflicting/aggregated title. New searches did not establish ANMF/AHA/Hospitality dates, university hours, Tribunal terms or allocation of the later full-time statement.
